verdict.rationale: Fastmail has dedicated first-party help articles for both halves of the story: 'Scheduled Send' for sending later and 'Undo send' for recalling a sent message. The pack contains only the article titles, though, not their contents, so the depth of each feature is unverified. Missing for 10: details on the undo grace-window length or configurability, specifics of scheduling options (time picker, editing or cancelling scheduled mail), independent or hands-on corroboration.
